title: В + accusative: On Tuesday, on Wednesday: the days of the week

blocks.text: В + Accusative is used to indicate the time of the day, the day of the week, and how frequently something occurs.

items.head: В + Accusative is used:
points: to indicate the time of the day
to indicate the day of the week
to indicate how frequently something occurs

items.text: Units smaller than a week (day, hour etc.) take „В + Acc.“

blocks.text: DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 19 and 73. One sentence at a time, in a new order each time you open this chapter; it is finished when every one has been answered right. The sentences are real: the source of each is shown with it.

exercises.why: «В + Accusative is used: (a) to indicate the time of the day; (b) to indicate the day of the week; (c) to indicate how frequently something occurs.» «Note also the following expressions: В минуту опасности. В годы войны. Во время войны. В первый раз. В следующий раз. В последний раз.» «Units smaller than a week (day, hour etc.) take „В + Acc.“» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 19 and 73.  ·  *Владимир Короленко, «История моего современника»*
